rationale: With only 8 minutes to close, the stock is pinned at the absolute top of its daily range (100th percentile) after a massive intraday move from ~$27.59 to $29.86, making a long entry extremely high-risk with minimal reward before forced liquidation. A short against a strong momentum move at the high with 8 minutes remaining and thin 1-minute candle volume is equally dangerous given the upward tape. The negative earnings news is already 22+ hours stale and clearly not driving price action, leaving no clean mechanical edge in either direction this close to the close.
